offers_products.reason: Sells LTL freight transportation; no goods or software are among its main offerings.

offers_services.reason: LTL, expedited, truckload brokerage, drayage and global freight transport for shippers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Business accounts with credit terms and Solutions Specialists; shippers are businesses.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Shippers are businesses, including manufacturers and retailers with delivery windows.

recurring_revenue.reason: Account customers ship repeatedly, with ongoing credit-terms invoicing and daily shipments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Freight volumes fall when industrial and retail activity slows; shippers can cut shipments.

big_ticket.reason: Individual LTL shipments are small, frequent, routine transportation purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on trucks, trailers and a network of 260+ service centers, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves a broad mix of businesses of all sizes; no focus on large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns tractors, trailers and 260+ service centers; network needs ongoing heavy capital investment.

notes: Customer size mix is inferred; the website doesn't state it.
